projects.name: Tfab service
projects.summary: Tflow/Tfab is a digital services platform that provides online payment processing and checkout solutions for digital products, software-related services, API integrations, technical setup, and support services.
projects.description:
The company works with e-commerce payments through banking and payment-provider infrastructure, including eComCharge and partner integrations such as FastPay.

The platform allows partners and clients to create payment requests, process card payments through a secure hosted checkout, track payment statuses, and manage settlements and reconciliation through an admin panel.
